_comment: Components card mining / export / ASR / live transcode require from the unified FFmpeg on EVERY platform. Builds are full component sets (no --disable-everything); this list is the floor that verify_ffmpeg_capabilities.py and the guard tests check. Names are as printed by `ffmpeg -encoders/-muxers/...`.

staged._comment: Capabilities a NEW build must carry before every platform's vendored artifact has been rebuilt with them. Builds check them with verify_ffmpeg_capabilities.py --require-staged (tool/bluray/build_libmpv.ps1 does); release checks of the already vendored artifacts do not. Promotion rule: an entry moves into the floor above (and is deleted here) only when the vendored artifact of EVERY platform carries it: Windows (libmpv archive, re-vendored with DVD 2026-10-24 as -dvd1), Android (AAR), iOS (xcframeworks) and macOS (ffmpeg-unified-macos.tar.gz); see tool/dvd/README.md and tool/dvd/forks/README.md. DVD: docs/specs/2026-10-24-dvd-original-menu.md (dvdvideo demuxer on the tool/dvd libraries, the same copies libmpv's dvd:// links).
